generation.scope: Three independent commutators of an irreducible traceless three-plane of 3-by-3 matrices cannot all send one fixed plane to one fixed line. Both the transverse and incident line cases force reducibility or a common self-adjoint form with only two independent compressed skew brackets. In every marked one-sided symmetric finite branch with unequal symmetric nets and three independent brackets the cubic determinant is nonzero. In particular the common plane of two symmetric nets with four-dimensional sum cannot commute.

open_mathematics: Choose an invertible commutator on the remaining unequal-net branches and determine the reconstruction on a fixed semisimple or regular Jordan cyclic chart. On graphs with fewer sites use residual pencils and re-marking together with the finite-graph square equations.
